name: Addon statistics - Invoicing detail screen (statsDetail)
description:
## Why

The Invoicing tab (https://teamdotblue.atlassian.net/browse/CZ3TDR1-658) moves the `statsSummary` screen to Partner Portal. Each row there links to a per-addon detail (`statsDetail`), which still lives in the legacy admin React page `ApiPartner?action=statsDetail`. No issue in this epic covers moving it, so the Portal summary would keep linking back to the legacy screen.

## What

Move the `statsDetail` screen to Partner Portal (same approach as the other Addon statistics screens):

- `frontend/apps/admin-web/src/Core/pages/ApiPartner/views/statsDetailView/` (`StatsDetailView.tsx`, `TotalsRow.tsx`, `table.tsx`)
- backend: `ApiPartnerController` `statsDetail` action and its props (`ApiPartnerStatsDetailProps`), extracted into a service in `cms/packages/PartnerPortal/Application/` that does not read the request
- guards `checkPartnerStatus()` / `checkDefaultCurrency()` need a Portal-side target instead of the legacy redirects

## Shared pieces

- `utils/statsFormat.ts` and `components/ColumnInfoLegend.tsx` are shared with `statsSummaryView`; reuse whatever CZ3TDR1-658 extracts, do not duplicate.
- `detailUrl` is built in PHP and hardcoded to the legacy `ApiPartner?action=statsDetail`. Once this screen exists, repoint it to the Portal route (Invoicing tab and this screen).

## Acceptance criteria

- Detail screen is reachable from the Portal Invoicing summary and shows the same data as the legacy one.
- Summary `detailUrl` no longer points to the legacy page.
- Legacy `statsDetailView` is removed or left only if still referenced (call out in the PR).
